benefits.titleZh: 談論人隨年齡和時間的轉變
benefits.titleEn: Talk about people changing as they get older
benefits.zh: grow up 和 grow into 可用來描述兒童、青少年或團體如何隨時間成長和發展。
benefits.en: Grow up and grow into help describe how children, teenagers and groups develop over time.

benefits.titleZh: 描述關係和喜好的轉變
benefits.zh: grow away from 表示人與人逐漸疏遠；grow on 則表示某事物逐漸變得討人喜歡。
benefits.en: Grow away from shows people becoming less close, while grow on shows something becoming more likeable.

benefits.titleEn: Talk naturally about hair and appearance
benefits.zh: grow back、grow out 和 grow something out 可用來談論剪髮、染髮和鬍鬚。
benefits.en: Grow back, grow out and grow something out are useful for talking about haircuts, hair colour and beards.

benefits.titleZh: 解釋衣物為何不再合身
benefits.titleEn: Explain why clothes no longer fit
benefits.zh: grow out of 可直接表示衣服或鞋子因人長大而變得太小。
benefits.en: Grow out of gives a direct way to say that clothes or shoes have become too small.

questions.prompt: The children are becoming older very quickly.
questions.promptZh: 孩子們很快便長大了。
questions.answer: The children are growing up very quickly.

questions.prompt: I did not like the song at first, but I began to like it after a few listens.
questions.promptZh: 起初我不喜歡這首歌，但聽了幾次後便開始喜歡它。

questions.answerZh: 聽了幾次後，我逐漸喜歡上這首歌，雖然起初我並不喜歡它。

questions.prompt: Maya slowly became less close to her childhood friend.
questions.promptZh: 瑪雅和兒時朋友逐漸不再那麼親近。
questions.answer: Maya slowly grew away from her childhood friend.
questions.answerZh: 瑪雅和兒時朋友逐漸疏遠。

questions.prompt: Lily’s shoes are too small because her feet have become bigger.
questions.promptZh: 莉莉的腳長大了，所以她的鞋子變得太小。
questions.answer: Lily has grown out of her shoes as her feet have become bigger.
questions.answerZh: 莉莉的腳長大了，鞋子已不再合穿。
questions.targetMeaningZh: 長大後因太小而不再合身

questions.prompt: The shy child became a confident teenager.
questions.promptZh: 那個害羞的孩子成長為一名有自信的青少年。

questions.answerZh: 那個害羞的孩子成長為一名有自信的青少年。

questions.answerZh: 紅色染髮正隨新髮長出而逐漸消失，露出她的天然髮色。
questions.targetMeaningZh: 染髮逐漸消失；髮型逐漸長走樣

questions.prompt: His hair returned after he cut it very short.

questions.answer: His hair grew back after he cut it very short.
questions.answerZh: 他把頭髮剪得很短後，頭髮又重新長出來。

questions.answerZh: 我決定把前蔭留長。
